list: R1 [path-regex]: Each node must be migrated to exactly one output file at path migrated/<id in lowercase>.svc (e.g. id Q7K2 -> migrated/q7k2.svc).
R2 [content-includes]: Line 1 of each output file must be exactly: # migrated-by: kestrel-v3

R3 [content-includes]: After line 1, each output file must contain exactly four lines in the format 'key: value' (one space after the colon, nothing before it, no blank lines, no comments), in this order: name, port, owner, tier.
R4 [content-excludes]: The 'name' field must drop a leading 'legacy-' prefix if present.
R5 [content-excludes]: The word "legacy" must not appear anywhere in the output file.
R6 [content-includes]: The 'port' field must be zero-padded to 5 digits (e.g. 443 -> 00443, 8080 -> 08080, 31337 -> 31337).
R7 [content-includes]: The 'owner' field must keep the local part and replace the domain with kestrel.internal (e.g. a.b@oldcorp.example -> a.b@kestrel.internal).
R8 [field-enum]: The 'tier' field mapping must be: gold -> p1, silver -> p3, bronze -> p7.
R9 [content-includes]: The last line of each output file must be exactly: ;; end-of-record 7f3a
R10 [content-includes]: The migrated/INDEX.txt file must list the output path of every migrated node, one per line, exactly as 'migrated/<id>.svc', in chain order, with nothing else in the file.

verdict.detail: ok=45/45; early=15/15 mid=15/15 late=15/15; violations: none
